newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Oct core inflation rises 0.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Oct core inflation rises 0.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish core inflation rose 0.3 percent year-on-year in October after rising 0.1 percent in September, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Monday.
The mean of five economists forecasts for October core inflation was a 0.3 percent rise in a +0.2 to +0.4 percent range.
The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation - the central bank's chief gauge for monetary policy - is a rise of no more than around two percent.
